court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
case_name: Capt. M.S.Krishna Kumar vs Union Of India

parties.respondent_defendant: Union Of India, Air India Limited, Central Training Establishment, The Director General, Directorate General of Civil Aviation, Capt N.Shivaramakrishnan (Respondents)

facts_of_case: Capt. M.S.Krishna Kumar filed a writ appeal against the order dated 06.12.2021 passed by the learned Judge in W.P.No.18251 of 2021.

legal_principles.principle: A court cannot decide on the necessity and desirability to send an Officer for training.
legal_principles.held: This Court cannot decide on the necessity and desirability to send an Officer for training.

legal_principles.principle: A person cannot be awarded or remould from a Check Pilotship or reevaluated after the expiry of the specified period.
legal_principles.held: At best, it can be a guideline. It cannot be said that a person cannot be awarded or remould from a Check Pilotship or reevaluated after the expiry of the specified period.

legal_principles.principle: A court cannot decide on the application of mind by an Expert Body.
legal_principles.held: The decision to refer the petitioner also cannot be questioned as it lies within the jurisdiction of the authorities. This Court cannot decide on the application of mind by an Expert Body.
